notes: The single PEPlife2 value of 90 min is verified against the Results text. METHODOLOGICAL CAVEAT: the half-life was not fitted - it is read directly off Figure 3 as the time at which concentration fell to half its initial value ('The peptide reached to the half of its initial concentration ... at 90 min making the plasma half-life of the peptide from the plot is 90 min'). That is a graphical time-to-50% rather than an exponential elimination half-life, and the two coincide only for a single-compartment first-order decay sampled from t=0. No dose, group size, dispersion, strain detail or fitting method is given in the body. The concentrations involved are very low (half of the initial value is 1.16 ng/mL), so the measurement sits near the assay's likely limit of quantitation.
